messages.subject: Output Problem
parts:
Hi everyone,
I launch irace and I got  an error.
The last line of the output of my program is -123334.984375. 

I set my target-runner :
COST=$(cat ${STDOUT} | grep -f ${STDOUT} | tail -1| cut -d ' ' -f2)
if ! [[ "$COST" =~ ^[-+0-9.e]+$ ]] ; then
    error "${STDOUT}: Output is not a number"
fi

the error message:
Error: == irace == The time returned by targetRunner is not numeric!

== irace == The call to targetRunner was:

/Users/mkrimi/target-runner 1 1 801596601 /Users/mkrimi/Instances/CdB-N-40-40-50-3tech-inst1    85 113 65 0.58248 0.01649

== irace == The output was:

parameters ,

-123334.984375

== irace == This is not a bug in irace, but means that something failed when running the command(s) above or they were terminated before completion. Try to run the command(s) above from the execution directory '/Users/mkrimi/TS-AM-I-arena' to investigate the issue.

Execution halted

did someone have any idea how can I solve this problem ?
